      The user will be asked to give name, the hours and minutes of the activity and then the date, and finally the maximum capacity of that activity in case of being a group lesson.

    • valoresSocio

      public void valoresSocio(Scanner input)
      Function

      This method asks for the identification number of the member and goes to fetch that member in the list of sociosIndividuais in case it's an Individual member otherwise it look at the list of sociosEmpresarios.
      In Case of the number not existing in either of theses lists it will send a message.
      If found, it aggregates all associated bookings to compute:

      • Total amount spent (sum of discounted final costs)
      • Total amount saved (difference between base prices and final costs)
      • Total number of bookings made
      Results are printed in a formatted summary including the member's name and ID.

      Parameters:
      input - Scanner name
